description_en: Used to create a reminder on a Tmall Genie device.
description_zh: 用于在天猫精灵设备上创建提醒
name: CreateReminder

fields.help_en: The detailed content of the reminder message
fields.help_zh: 提醒信息的详细内容
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: Genie ID
fields.help_zh: 精灵id
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: Device ID
fields.help_zh: 设备id
fields.name: device_id

fields.help_en: Application ID
fields.help_zh: 应用id
fields.name: subject_id

fields.help_en: Indicates whether this invocation is for debug purposes
fields.help_zh: 该调用是否为调试
fields.name: is_debug

fields.help_en: The year of the time when the reminder is triggered
fields.help_zh: 触发提醒的时间年份
fields.name: year

fields.help_en: The month in which the reminder is triggered
fields.help_zh: 触发提醒的时间月份
fields.name: month

fields.help_en: The date on which the reminder is triggered
fields.help_zh: 触发提醒的时间日期
fields.name: day

fields.help_en: The hour of the time when the reminder is triggered
fields.help_zh: 触发提醒的时间时钟数
fields.name: hour

fields.help_en: The minute of the time when the reminder is triggered
fields.help_zh: 触发提醒的时间分钟数
fields.name: minute

fields.help_en: The second of the time when the reminder is triggered
fields.help_zh: 触发提醒的时间秒钟数
fields.name: second

fields.help_en:
Loop type:

ONCE: One-time
DAILY: Daily
WEEKLY: Weekly
MONTHLY: Monthly
fields.help_zh:
循环类型：

ONCE：单次
DAILY：每天
WEEKLY：每周
MONTHLY：每月
fields.name: freq

fields.help_en: The effective start time of the reminder, in milliseconds as a UNIX timestamp
fields.help_zh: 提醒开始的生效时间，时间戳毫秒
fields.name: start_date_time

fields.help_en: The expiration time when the reminder ends, in milliseconds UNIX timestamp
fields.help_zh: 提醒结束的失效时间，时间戳毫秒
fields.name: end_date_time

fields.help_en: Configure monthly reminders, indicating the day of the month when the reminder is triggered
fields.help_zh: 设置按月提醒，即每月几日触发提醒
fields.name: days_of_month

fields.help_en: Configure weekly reminders, indicating on which days of the week the reminder is triggered
fields.help_zh: 设置按周提醒，即每周几触发提醒
fields.name: days_of_week

fields.help_en: Scheduling information for the reminder
fields.help_zh: 提醒的调度信息
fields.name: recurrence_rule

parameters.help_en: The input parameters for this service request
parameters.name: payload

fields.help_en: User identifier, set to either userOpenId or userUnionId
fields.help_zh: 用户标识，设置为userOpenId或userUnionId
fields.name: id

fields.help_en:
Type of the User ID:  
OPEN_ID: The default User ID identity.  
UNION_ID: The User ID identity at the organization dimension. This value is available only after an organization has been requested on the Tmall Genie Skills Application Platform
fields.help_zh:
用户Id的类型：
OPEN_ID：默认的用户ID标识。
UNION_ID: 组织维度的用户ID标识，在天猫精灵技能应用平台申请了组织后才会有该值
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the user identifier for Tmall Genie, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type.  
PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name, used in the Android application customer flow  
SKILL_ID: Skill ID, used in the cloud-based flow
fields.help_zh:
编码类型，获取天猫精灵的用户标识的途径有多种，不同途径对应不同的编码类型。
PACKAGE_NAME：apk包名，Android应用客户链路的编码类型 
SKILL_ID：技能ID，云端链路的编码类型
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en:
The value corresponding to the encoding type:  
When the encoding type is SKILL_ID, the value is the Skill ID of the application.  
When the encoding type is PACKAGE_NAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app
fields.help_zh:
编码类型对应的值
编码类型是SKILL_ID时，其值为应用的Skill ID。
编码类型是PACKAGE_NAME时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en: Organization ID. This parameter is required when IdType is configured as UNION_ID
fields.help_zh: 组织ID，IdType配置为UNION_ID时，该参数必填
fields.name: organization_id

fields.help_en: Device ID, set to either deviceOpenId or deviceUnionId.
fields.help_zh: 设备标识，设置为deviceOpenId或deviceUnionId
fields.name: id

fields.help_en:
Type of the device ID:  
OPEN_ID: Default device ID identifier.  
UNION_ID: Organization-level device ID identifier. This value is available only after an organization has been registered on the Tmall Genie Skill Application Open Platform
fields.help_zh:
设备Id的类型 
OPEN_ID：默认的设备ID标识 
UNION_ID: 组织维度的设备ID标识，在天猫精灵技能应用开放平台申请过组织后才会有该值
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the device ID for Tmall Genie, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type.  
PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name, used in the Android application customer flow.  
SKILL_ID: Skill ID, used in the cloud-based flow.
fields.help_zh:
编码类型，获取天猫精灵的设备标识的途径有多种，不同途径对应不同的编码类型。
PACKAGE_NAME：apk包名，Android应用客户链路的编码类型 。
SKILL_ID：技能ID，云端链路的编码类型
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en:
The value corresponding to the encoding type.

When the encoding type is set to SKILL_ID, the value is the application's Skill ID.
When the encoding type is set to PACKAGE_NAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app
fields.help_zh:
编码类型对应的值

编码类型设置为SKILL_ID时，其值为应用的Skill ID。
编码类型设置为PACKAGE_NAME时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en: Organization ID. This parameter is required when IdType is set to UNION_ID.
fields.help_zh: 组织ID，IdType设置为UNION_ID时，该参数必填
fields.name: organization_id
